items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: But Joy Boyer, Walter Preston, Joe Gable, Chani Foster. And them guys kept forcing me to quit Jack and let's get us own band.

ctx.x: Let me see. I bought John Jack in 20.

And I would have stayed with him all the time. And I would have stayed with him all the time. But Joy Boyer, Walter Preston, Joe Gable, Chani Foster. And them guys kept forcing me to quit Jack and let's get us own band. They did that a long time before I quit. But I said, well all right, I said we're going to put the band in your name. Kept on- I didn't want to quit Jack. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. They just kept forcing me to quit Jack and let's get us our own band. They did that a long time before I quit. But I…
Why did they want to quit Jack?
